args.lesson: System spec with 32-request/us burst: run_dse with the full 400 evals gave a 36-design feasible front, all top designs in the pipelined_m family with m=4 (throughput 93.6 msps, ~3x the 32 msps requirement). L2 simulation moved sys_p99_batch_us from the 0.3848 analytic bound to 0.3953 simulated (limit 0.44) - the analytic bound was slightly optimistic but the margin held, so the L1 winner survived. Winner: pipelined_m data_width=18,n_iter=14,angle_guard=1,frac_guard=0,rounding=trunc,m=4 at luts_plus_ffs=1127, accuracy_bits=12 (max_abs_err 2^-12.03, just over the 2^-12 requirement). Lesson: for burst-throughput specs, pipelined_m with m=4 dominates; keep accuracy_bits at or just above the requirement to minimise area, but note the margin is thin (2^-12.03 vs 2^-12) so a small calibration shift could break feasibility. L3/L4/L5 had no recorded data for this design (back_annotate = no_measured_data), so estimates stayed unconfirmed.
